auth: 1. No account needed for the public feed; the tenant applies on the posting's own application page (assist card).

adapter.terms: jobs.wordpress.net public WordPress feed. Contact details are on each job page.

search_postings.note: The feed answers its whole current list in one response (WordPress RSS 2.0, the latest 10 job posts); query, category, min_budget, page and limit are not sent (the feed documents no parameters) — filter the returned postings client-side and ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). id is the job's permalink; description is the full post (content:encoded, HTML); the short excerpt is raw.description and the WordPress post id raw['post-id'].

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The feed has no per-item endpoint; each posting's page (url) is HTML only. search_postings returns the whole record.
not_offered.submit_bid: Each post lists how to apply (e-mail or link); the site has no application API and its REST index exposes no job type.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; only the public feed is machine-readable.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; only the public feed is machine-readable.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the feed is keyless.

live_check.notes: fixed (runtime): the feed sends no page parameter but advertised next_page and repeated page 1; next_page is now null; all read tools answered, schema-valid
